name: ONED USD
oneLiner: ONED is a Gennius-branded dollar token backed by USDC held by Coinbase, with 1:1 conversion for eligible Coinbase accounts.
collateral: USDC held in Coinbase custody, with itemized Base reserve wallets. Holder reserve title and creditor-claim exclusions are contractual; shared addresses are permitted and statutory bankruptcy remoteness is unverified.
pegMechanism: Eligible Coinbase accounts can deposit native Base ONED from external wallets and convert it 1:1 with USDC, less any Coinbase fees. New York, Canada and the European Economic Area are excluded on Coinbase. Requests may be delayed, paused or refused under Coinbase's terms, with no published completion maximum. Copies, wrapped and bridged ONED are not redeemable under native holder terms.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Base token is a distinct Coinbase Custom Stablecoin for Gennius, backed 1:1 by Coinbase-custodied USDC and convertible by eligible accounts. Its fiat-cash archetype describes custodial reserve issuance and conversion rather than borrower collateral or a NAV fund; immediate backing remains crypto-backed USDC. Coinbase US User Agreement Appendix 4 sections 13.1.1-13.1.3 gives holders transferable reserve ownership and economic value and risk, establishing a wrapper/serial claim even though conversion is custodian-managed. Native ONED terms expressly incorporate those terms. Sections 2.7.1-2.7.4 establish contractual custody protections and permit shared addresses, without independently verified statutory bankruptcy remoteness. The October 15 dashboard and Base block 52635892 corroborate current reserve composition, not financial assurance or executable exit capacity.
